title: 2024 Trend Check
notes: Free interactive page, first archived 2023-12-15 (published on or before that date). '15 distinct industry trends', one per industry (industry recorded as section), each with a label, subtitle, intro paragraph (quote taken from it) and three cross-industry opportunity examples (not recorded). The intro frames the year around the 'Exchange Economy'. The full 2024 Trend Report (Premium) is not captured. target_year 2024 from the title.

entries.label: SUSTAINABILITY ON DISPLAY
entries.quote: And consumers, as climate urgency intensifies, are rejecting greenwashing and seeking genuinely impactful efforts.
entries.subject: Visible sustainability in beauty
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Deeper shades of green in beauty'.

entries.label: CODE-IT-YOURSELF
entries.quote: The adoption of LLMs and text-to-anything software created a newfound willingness to play and experiment, giving rise to a CODE-IT-YOURSELF mindset.
entries.subject: Consumer customization of technology with generative AI

entries.label: COMMON TONGUE
entries.quote: As tensions spill over at a global and local level, entertainment brands are turning to universal mediums of expression – laughter, music, gaming – to remind consumers of their shared humanity.
entries.subject: Entertainment bridging polarization
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Reconnecting a divided world through entertainment'.

entries.label: BRANDCARE
entries.quote: This includes apparel: half of consumers globally ( 49% ) expect fashion brands to play a role in making sure they are as healthy as possible.
entries.subject: Fashion combined with health and wellbeing
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Fashion brands take a more active role in caring for consumers' health'.

entries.label: FUTURE PROOFED
entries.quote: In response, financial services need to move beyond transactions and share their knowledge riches.
entries.subject: Financial literacy services
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Building financial literacy in a complex economic context'.

entries.label: ECO-BOOSTERS
entries.quote: A new wave of food and beverage consumers don’t want to just ‘cause less harm’, they want to go further, returning more to nature than they take.
entries.subject: Regenerative food and drink
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Sustenance that gives back to nature'.

entries.label: VIRTUAL COMPANIONS
entries.quote: While some chatbots offer productivity upgrades or shopping assistance, others are emerging to ease overstretched health services.
entries.subject: AI chatbots in healthcare
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Next-gen AI chatbots alleviate overburdened health systems'. Same label as the 2018 trend VIRTUAL COMPANIONS.

entries.label: OFF-GRID GUERRILLAS
entries.quote: Off-grid living is an increasingly affordable way of life that can support various lifestyles, with no need to forgo modern comforts.
entries.subject: Off-grid, self-sufficient homes

entries.label: CULTURAL CREDITORS
entries.quote: Beyond the store, longer-term activations that highlight tradition will fuel the idea that luxury brands don’t just build on existing culture, they also shape it.
entries.subject: Luxury brands as cultural patrons
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Luxury brands become beacons of culture'.

entries.label: SYNCED SERVICES
entries.quote: With more disruptive technologies expected in 2024, it seems even the most basic expectations can still be hard to meet
entries.subject: Integrated multi-service mobility
entries.note: Subtitle: 'One mobility option, multiple seamlessly integrated services'.

entries.label: DRAFTED BY AI
entries.quote: NGOs, the most trusted source of information, must lead the way in wielding AI as a force for good.
entries.subject: Generative AI use by nonprofits

entries.label: GREEN THEATER
entries.quote: Turn in-store shopping experiences into eco theaters that clearly communicate green credentials and validate net-zero pledges .
entries.subject: In-store sustainability showcases
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Eco-initiatives take center stage in retail stores'. Heading prints 'GREEN THEATER'; the intro prints 'GREEN THEATRE'.

entries.label: FACTUAL HEALING
entries.quote: there are opportunities for brands to implement community-led control measures that ease consumer concerns about generative AI and the ever-expanding reach of misinformation.
entries.subject: Countering AI-generated misinformation
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Generative AI — truth friend or foe?'.

entries.label: BRAND BUTLERS
entries.quote: To reaffirm trust, hospitality brands need to implement no-nonsense shortcuts and benefits that put consumer needs first.
entries.subject: Trust-building perks in travel
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Rebuilding trust with perks and add-ons'. Same label as the 2008 trend BRAND BUTLERS.

entries.label: SKILLS FOR ALL
entries.quote: Both employees and students require a broader understanding of analytical and generative AI: how it can be utilized, its impact and how to think with it.
entries.subject: AI skills training
